description: GEOX Biostratigraphy MCP Governance — Truth-Class Hygiene. 11-label truth taxonomy mapped to MCP governance with transition rules, constraints, and violation handling. Ensures biostrat outputs respect evidence-class boundaries.
doctrine: Biostratigraphy calibrates the Earth model. It does not replace the Earth.

OBSERVATION_DIRECT.definition: Earth physically answered — oil flowed, core recovered, pressure measured
OBSERVATION_DIRECT.violation: Claiming biostrat proves hydrocarbon presence — category error

OBSERVATION_MATERIAL.violation: Claiming cuttings observation is equivalent to core observation

OBSERVATION_BIOLOGICAL.definition: Fossil/taxon/biozone observed in sample — what was actually seen
OBSERVATION_BIOLOGICAL.violation: Reporting 'Middle Miocene' without citing which fossils — collapsing observation into interpretation

OBSERVATION_PROXY.definition: Indirect measured signal — logs, seismic amplitude, mud gas
OBSERVATION_PROXY.violation: Treating resistivity as direct oil indicator without sampling

INTERPRETATION_LOCAL.definition: Immediate geological meaning at sample/well scale
INTERPRETATION_LOCAL.violation: Claiming local observation has basin-wide significance without testing

INTERPRETATION_STRATIGRAPHIC.definition: Correlation, time, surface, or sequence interpretation
INTERPRETATION_STRATIGRAPHIC.violation: Claiming 'NN5 = Middle Miocene = prospect works' — collapsing interpretation into commercial claim

MODEL_STATIC.definition: Structural or depositional model — organization of interpreted data
MODEL_STATIC.violation: Presenting model as observation — 'the kitchen is here' without evidence

MODEL_DYNAMIC.definition: Process model — how things happened over time
MODEL_DYNAMIC.violation: Presenting slab-breakoff as observation rather than geodynamic model

CLAIM_EXPLORATION.violation: Claiming 'biostrat proves the prospect' — biostrat cannot prove commerciality

EUREKA_LEAP.definition: Insight ahead of proof — pattern recognition before evidence complete
EUREKA_LEAP.violation: Entering eureka leap into database as fact without labelling

FAITH_STORY.definition: Unsupported narrative — aesthetic preference, not evidence
FAITH_STORY.violation: Allowing faith story to influence exploration decisions without evidence gate

transition_rules.rule_1: DOWNGRADE is always allowed — you can reduce confidence, you cannot fabricate certainty
transition_rules.rule_2: UPGRADE requires evidence gate — you must provide new independent evidence to move up
transition_rules.rule_3: Collapsing layers (skipping truth classes) is a GOVERNANCE VIOLATION — must be flagged
transition_rules.rule_4: Biostrat-specific: OBSERVATION_BIOLOGICAL → INTERPRETATION_STRATIGRAPHIC requires calibration, facies check, and multi-discipline convergence
transition_rules.rule_5: Claims cannot be upgraded to OBSERVATION_DIRECT without physical Earth response (flow, core, pressure)

fossil_to_age.forbidden: Direct fossil-to-age without calibration, zone name, or facies check

age_to_play.forbidden: Claiming prospect validity from biostrat alone

biostrat_to_commercial.forbidden: ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN. Biostrat cannot prove commerciality. Only flow, core, pressure, and fluid recovery can.

V1_CATEGORY_ERROR.description: Claim from wrong truth class — e.g. biostrat observation presented as commercial proof
V1_CATEGORY_ERROR.action: REJECT with explanation of correct truth class

V2_COLLAPSED_LAYER.description: Skipping truth classes — e.g. fossil name directly to age without calibration

V3_OVERP RECISION.description: Claiming confidence HIGH when evidence supports MED-LOW

V4_UNFALSIFIABLE.description: Claim too vague to test — cannot be falsified

constitutional_alignment.F2_TRUTH: Every claim must carry truth-class label. Evidence_for and evidence_against mandatory.
constitutional_alignment.F4_CLARITY: Truth-class boundaries enforced. No category mixing without documentation.
constitutional_alignment.F6_MARUAH: Scientific dignity — falsification is progress, not failure.
constitutional_alignment.F7_HUMILITY: Confidence capped per truth class. OBSERVATION_BIOLOGICAL max 0.85.
